purpose: All verbs of Werkwoordspelling with every form written out (144 verbs).
details: Loaded by kern/taal/werkwoorden.py (PAD). Per verb: inf, stam (the ik form), tt = [ik, jij, hij, plural], vt = [singular, plural], vd (participle), hulp (hebben or zijn), vt_soort and vd_soort (zwak following 't kofschip, a test recomputes every weak form, or sterk = learn by heart), ge (false = the participle has no ge-), niveau 1-3 (from very common to harder), rest (what can follow the verb), and optional o (own subjects), ook (extra accepted ik-forms), vroeger (past sounds better with 'vroeger' than 'gisteren') and onregelmatig (the present tense does not follow stem + t).

field_notes.explanation: The list of verbs with all forms and flags.
